# Let Me Know 0.9.0
- Apple-notarisiert und mit Developer ID signiert. - Banner und Hinweistöne ab macOS 13; Audio-Ducking ab macOS 14.2. - Bei aktiviertem Ducking und fehlendem oder fehlgeschlagenem Audiozugriff erscheint bei neuen echten Benachrichtigungen eine eigene Freigabe-Nachfrage. - Ducking ausgeschaltet: keine Nachfrage. macOS entscheidet, ob sein Systemdialog erneut erscheint.
Apple Silicon. Test-V1-Installationen verwenden bewusst keinen automatischen Produktions-Updatekanal.

# Let Me Know 0.8.2 — Preview
- Small square images appear as compact, uncropped 112-point previews in notifications. - Banner content is measured before attachment to a reused window, with an explicit natural height to prevent image-area clipping. - Image clicks still open the originating chat.
Apple silicon preview; Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.

# Let Me Know 0.8.1 — Preview
- Redesigned Mac app icon: very dark green background with the original green mark. - Updated icon resource name to refresh Finder and Dock artwork.
Apple silicon preview; Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.

# Let Me Know 0.8.0 — Preview
Global AI Ping is now **Let Me Know**. Existing sounds, settings, connection hooks and the signed update channel are preserved.
- Six clearer setup steps: welcome, audio, detected apps, startup, sounds, finish. - Centered floating setup window, with system permission dialogs allowed above it. - Audio verification reports success only after a live audio path has been established. - Automatic connection of detected local Codex / Claude Code profiles and a rescan action. - Global sound selection with previews and buttons to open connected apps. - Closing unfinished setup quits the app and resumes at the saved step next time. Closing the completion page leaves the app running. - Notifications are suppressed during setup.
macOS may request audio permission again; the app cannot force or bypass a system permission prompt. Apple silicon preview. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.
